png_visual.scope: Full-page PDF and SVG review of graphics, roundtrip, explicit Native and default DOCX; baseline/style/curves/fill/stroke/clip/page breaks checked. Latest-source contact sheets confirm full 16-page scope.

preview.reviewer: Codex primary agent using native macOS Preview UI
preview.chain: Graphics API -> native OFD -> PDF -> Preview; licensed DOCX -> explicit Native/default OFD -> PDF -> Preview
preview.initial_file_chooser_failure: Recovered via Finder; actual paths confirmed in Preview before page inspection. No substitute rendering used for Preview result.
observations: All 8 pages inspected at full-page scale; ticket title/grid and typography additionally viewed enlarged.
Chinese/Latin text, local bold/italic/color, baseline guides and rotated stamp are legible and remain local.
Anisotropic stroke, cubic/quadratic curves, EvenOdd hole/NonZero fill and frozen clip match the deterministic sample.
Native/default table fill/borders, alignment and explicit two-page break match the licensed DOCX fixture.
No observed missing glyphs, duplicate paint, unexpected crop/overlap or extra blank pages in this scope.

limitations: Single-baseline text; no wrapping or new font metrics/shaping service.
Solid pen/brush only; no gradients/shaders/advanced blend/hairline.
No flow/table/Canvas or Skia adapter additions.
Font subset/reuse/fallback is ticket 05; explicit package-local identity contract only.
Name-only font text depends on reader environment. Public artifacts embed pinned OFL Noto only.
Current-head external reviews/CI remain required before ticket closure.
